package com.acme.crm.address;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class AddressFormatterTest {

    private AddressFormatter formatter;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        formatter = new AddressFormatter();
    }

    @Test
    void formatsSingaporeAddressOnTwoLines() {
        Address a = new Address("10 Anson Road", "#12-01", "079903", "SG");
        assertThat(formatter.format(a)).isEqualTo("10 Anson Road #12-01\nSingapore 079903");
    }

    @Test
    void omitsMissingUnitNumber() {
        Address a = new Address("1 Fusionopolis Way", null, "138632", "SG");
        assertThat(formatter.format(a)).isEqualTo("1 Fusionopolis Way\nSingapore 138632");
    }

    @Test
    void uppercasesCountryCode() {
        assertThat(formatter.countryLine("sg")).isEqualTo("SINGAPORE");
    }
}
